CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

permission_core.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_has_permission_core(p_user_id uuid, p_target text, p_mode text DEFAULT 'view'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_allowed boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF p_mode NOT IN ('view', 'edit') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid mode: %, expected view or edit', p_mode;
  END IF;

  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p_mode = 'view' THEN can_view
      WHEN p_mode = 'edit' THEN can_edit
      ELSE false
    END
  INTO v_allowed
  FROM public.user_permissions_canonical
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    AND target = p_target;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_allowed, false);
END;
$function$
